summary: Preserve addListener as the on() alias with identical ordering and return-value semantics.

target.notes: addListener is an alias of on; use the same helper contract rather than defining a second listener store.

caveats: If addListener itself is monkey-patched, fall back to ordinary property lookup/call semantics.

tests.name: alias registers
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; e.addListener('x',()=>n++); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);

tests.name: duplicate alias registrations
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); let n=0; function f(){n++} e.addListener('x',f).addListener('x',f); e.emit('x'); console.log(n);
